summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that George Morrow offered to bet $500 that Tom Allen could not knock out J. Miles in four rounds, but the offer proved a bluff; no man or money could be found.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, January 6, 1883, page 5.

facts.fact: George Morrow offered to bet $500 that Allen could not knock out J. Miles in four three-minute rounds under Queensberry rules; the challenge was judged a bluff and no backer or money was found

notes: Current summary wrongly says Allen was to knock out 'J. Miles and other fighters'; the second offer was to match Miles against the O'Connell-Walling winner.
